title: ASCENT — The Cipher Worlds
subtitle: Adaptive Algebra I mastery, built to a Fortnite / Breath of the Wild bar
summary: Live at robglnn.github.io/aadmath. The cold-player gate is 18 steps and passes against production, including play with pointer lock denied. A blind cold critic scored 7.5/10 and passed; a department head passed the teacher record for adoption at 8/10 in both TEKS and Common Core framings. Algebra I Level 1 and Level 2 ship; content is data, so Algebra II, Geometry and Trigonometry are a decision rather than a build.
